text:
jess (AE): SolsticePay POC kickoff. They want a drop-in swap from CompetitorX -> Redwood. Goals: HTTP compatibility, prompt parity, and comparable billing for POC. Can the SE/ML/security folks scope a 2-week run? cc @omar @mitch @nina

omar (SE): I can build a small proxy shim to translate their requests. Need 50-200 sample calls + 5 full chat sessions. Main mismatches: streaming frames vs single-response, stop-token defaults, and session affinity. Will aim for an EOD smoke if samples arrive.

mitch (ML Eng): For parity we'll run embedding-sim tests + response delta. Ask them for ~250 golden prompts and acceptance thresholds. I'll run rwd-full and rwd-quant variants and share top divergence cases. 48-72h for first report.

nina (Security): They flagged PCI and EU data residency. Send the security questionnaire before provisioning: retention, KMS, SOC2, RBAC, ingress IP allowlist. If they require no cloud egress, we pivot to Private deploy.

li (SRE): Capacity note: if they want sub-200ms p50 at 100 TPS, recommend Dedicated with session-affinity. We'll emulate CompetitorX KV behavior in the proxy to avoid cold-start latency.

jess (AE): Pricing Q: they requested token-for-token comparison and a month trial credit. For POC we typically provide credits + raw usage logs for reconciliation. I'll draft terms.

omar (SE): Proxy smoke curl:
``` 
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood/generate \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \\ 
  -d '{"prompt":"{{prompt}}","max_tokens":200,"stream":false}'
```
Responsibilities: rewrite stop sequences, normalize chunked streams into a single JSON payload, and map session-id -> affinity-key.

mitch (ML Eng): Eval plan: pairwise embedding cosine + token-delta histogram for 250 prompts. Will output CSV + annotated examples.

nina (Security): I posted the questionnaire link in DM. Also: we need their legal contact for DPA/KMS details.

jess (AE): Action items: Omar - shim + smoke; Mitch - eval harness; Nina - security chase; Li - Dedicated sizing. I'll update customer after smoke.

deploy-bot: Staging deployment queued: staging/proxy-solsticepay @ 1799993600. Lock that cluster until tests finish.

omar (SE): Starting now, ping if samples are uploaded.

mitch (ML Eng): Will begin once prompts land.

nina (Security): Tracking in the security board.

jess (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
